question: Could you find out the average percentage of the total lifetime sales (LTV) that occur in the first 7 and 30 days after a customer's initial purchase? Also, include the average total lifetime sales (LTV). Please exclude customers with zero lifetime sales. The 7- and 30-day periods should be based on the exact number of hours-minutes-seconds, not calendar days.
sql:
-- Final result without rounding to keep precision
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) as total_ltv
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_7day AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as amount_7day
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
    WHERE p.payment_date >= cf.first_payment
      AND p.payment_date < cf.first_payment + INTERVAL '7' DAY
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
),
customer_30day AS (
    SELECT p.customer_id, SUM(p.amount) as amount_30day
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_first_payment cf ON p.customer_id = cf.customer_id
    WHERE p.payment_date >= cf.first_payment
      AND p.payment_date < cf.first_payment + INTERVAL '30' DAY
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(c7.amount_7day, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END) as avg_pct_7day,
    AVG(CASE WHEN cl.total_ltv > 0 THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(c30.amount_30day, 0) / cl.total_ltv * 100 ELSE 0 END) as avg_pct_30day,
    AVG(cl.total_ltv) as avg_total_ltv
FROM customer_first_payment cf
JOIN customer_ltv cl ON cf.customer_id = cl.customer_id
LEFT JOIN customer_7day c7 ON cf.customer_id = c7.customer_id
LEFT JOIN customer_30day c30 ON cf.customer_id = c30.customer_id
WHERE cl.total_ltv > 0
